title: The runner's settings copy is taken from the worktree file, so a committed settings change in a worktree ahead of origin/main is copied and read
goal: autopilot.copy_runner_settings copies the settings file from the committed origin/main revision (git show origin/main:.claude/settings.json) and not from the worktree file, so a settings change committed in a worktree that is ahead of origin/main is never read by a run; a test named runner_settings_from_origin_main plants a worktree commit that widens an allow rule and shows the copy still holds the origin/main rules; a missing origin/main file stays the existing refusal. Found by mac-sixth landing BG-mewv4st5 (follow-up 3).

run: import sys; sys.exit(0 if 'origin/main:.claude/settings.json' in open('_tools/autopilot.py').read() else 1)

repro_reason: the gap is the source of the copy; the text match shows whether the code reads the settings from origin/main
